name: PD 158 was established by Ordinance No. 18031, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 26, 1983. Ordinance No. 18031 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18031; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 158 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 158 was established by Ordinance No. 18031, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 26, 1983. Ordinance No. 18031 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18031; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 158 is established on property generally located at the southwest corner of Winton Street and Alderson Street. The size of PD 158 is approximately 1.81 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18031; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-158.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development must be in accordance with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 158A). (Ord. Nos. 18031; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.105.USES. The only uses permitted in this PD are those uses permitted in a duplex district. (Ord. Nos. 18031; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.106.DENSITY. Development is limited to a maximum of 11 lots. (Ord. Nos. 18031; 25508)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.107.DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS. Maximum permitted building height is 24 feet. Front yard setbacks and lot widths must be provided as shown on the approved development plan. All other standards for development in this PD are the same as the standards for a duplex district contained in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 18031; 25508)

sections.title: Alley
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.108.ALLEY. Prior to occupancy of any dwelling unit in this PD, the entire alley between Alderson Street and Norris Street must be paved at no expense to the city and constructed in accordance with the requirements of the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18031; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.109.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development must comply with all codes and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18031; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.110.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18031; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.111.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy until there is full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18031; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-158.112.ZONING MAP. PD 158 is located on Zoning Map No. H-8. (Ord. Nos. 18031; 25508)
